entries.a108eab0a906c5f8: Under its mission, “to realize a society full of meaning by providing opportunities for transformation to organizations and individuals through Motivation Engineering,” the company intends to focus on the consulting and cloud business of the Organizational Development Division, which has high growth potential, and to pursue stabilization and recurring revenue centered on “Motivation Cloud.” It intends to expand its existing services to mid-sized and small companies in Japan, advance cloud-based offerings in new areas, and pursue overseas expansion in 5 Asian countries. In April 2026, it plans to release “Motivation Cloud Entry Management,” a cloud service for recruitment support.
